tasks.label: scan-missing-html-links
args: $root='frontend'; $files=Get-ChildItem $root -File -Recurse | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.html','.js' }; $refs=@(); foreach($f in $files){ $content=Get-Content $f.FullName -Raw; [regex]::Matches($content,'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.html') | ForEach-Object { $refs += [pscustomobject]@{File=$f.Name; Ref=$_.Value} } }; $existing=(Get-ChildItem $root -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name); $missing=$refs | Where-Object { $existing -notcontains $_.Ref } | Sort-Object Ref -Unique; if($missing.Count -eq 0){ 'No missing linked HTML files found.' } else { $missing | Select-Object -First 100 | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String }
